text:
rachel_cs: Quick update from Pendulum Finance onboarding call (recap). They surfaced 3 product asks + a couple of pain points. Need triage for prioritization before renewal convo next week.

rachel_cs: Asks: 1) per-customer model routing rules (prefer lower-cost gen for non-sensitive flows), 2) exportable, tamper-evident prompt+response audit logs for compliance, 3) embedding refresh controls (TTL + reindex window) and a simple UI toggle for customer ops.

rachel_cs: Pain points: bursty test traffic caused a 3x bill spike on day 2, onboarding UI confusing when creating multi-key/service accounts, and lack of clear docs showing fallback behavior when Dedicated capacity is down.

rachel_cs: Renewal risk flag: customer said "we like Redwood but need clearer cost controls or we'll pause the pilot". Can product + eng weigh in on quick wins? @sam_product @diego_engineer

rachel_cs: Attached notes paste: ````
- customer: Pendulum Finance (mid-market fintech)
- pilot size: 2 services, ~25k tokens/day typical, 200k spikes during batch jobs
- compliance: needs immutable audit exports weekly
````

tasha_csm: +1 on the TTL toggle for embeddings — ops team asked for that specifically for their nightly reindex window. Also they asked for a visual of per-route cost estimates during config (simple projected dollars).

sam_product: Thanks — high level thoughts: all three map to separate workstreams. Quick wins: (a) surface estimated cost per-route in Console (UI + heuristics) — low effort, high impact; (b) embedding TTL toggle — medium effort but unblockable. Audit logs are higher compliance work (immutable exports + retention).

sam_product: Can we scope the audit export as an "S3-compatible weekly manifest" first, then iterate to HSM/KMS-backed immutability if needed? That gives them something before renewal. @diego_engineer thoughts on effort?

diego_engineer: Agree with priority. Rough estimates: cost-estimates UI: 2 dev days + 1 PM polish. Embedding TTL + toggle: 1 sprint (infra + console + small migration). Audit export (S3 manifest) MVP: ~3 sprints (auth, export pipeline, manifest, docs). Immutable/HSM follow-up TBD.

diego_engineer: Implementation note: for per-customer model routing rules, we can reuse existing policy routing table but need a UI layer + validation and default fallback. Backend work: ~2 sprints for safe rollout with canary.

rachel_cs: That sounds good. Can we aim for: cost-estimates UI + embedding TTL as immediate patch (next sprint), start audit export MVP in parallel but marked as "enterprise"? If yes I'll escalate with Pendulum and set expectations.

sam_product: Yes. I'll create a short RFC and slot the UI + TTL into next sprint. I'll mark audit export as enterprise/longer lead. I'll post RFC link here when ready.

ops_bot: New RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1357 (Pendulum onboarding asks). Reviewers: sam_product, diego_engineer, rachel_cs. ETA for draft: 48h. :white_check_mark:

rachel_cs: Great — thanks team. I'll update Pendulum that we can deliver cost-estimate UI + TTL toggle next sprint and that audit exports are tracked as enterprise work.

tasha_csm: Also asked if we can do a 30m walkthrough of the Console cost view next Tuesday. I'll coordinate calendar — flagging as enablement request.

sam_product: Add enablement as acceptance criteria for the UI task (30m walkthrough + quick start doc).

rachel_cs: Perfect. Closing the loop here — will post follow-up notes and customer quote once I confirm renewal meeting. :pray:
